main_text.head: CAPUT IV. De cognatis Physicæ.
main_text.p: Disciplinæ & artes Physicæ cognatæ. Thes. I. Disciplinarum circa res naturales occupatarum distributio ab Algazele tradita: ἐχϑ.[?] Medica disciplina. Thes. II. Medicina non est pars Physicæ, sed disciplina ei subordinata: ἐχϑ.[?] male dividitur in speculativam & practi-cam: ibid. Alchymia: Thes. III. An invicem metalla possint transmutari: ἐχϑ.[?] Magia naturalis. Th. IV. Thaumaturgica quid sit. Th. V. Vox Magiæ olim honestissima: unde infamiam traxerit: ἐχϑ.1. Thomas Erastus negat dari magiam naturalem; cui plurimi contradi-cunt. 2. Exemplis ostenditur dari magiam natura-lem. 3. Magia divinatricis species: Th. VI. Astrologia judi-ciaria. Th. VII. Distinctio eorum, quæ ex astris prædi-cuntur: ἐχϑ.1. Abusus astrologiæ: 2. Physiognomia: Th. VIII. Exempla prædictionis physiognomicæ: ἐχϑ.[?] Chiromantia. Th. IX. Abusus Chiromantiæ: ἐχϑ.1. An Adstrui possit ex Iob. 37. v. 6.? 2. Magia illicita & daemoniaca. 3. Thaumaturgica. 4. An Apollonius Tyaneus exercuerit magiam licitam? 5. Divinatricis magiæ illicitæ species. 6.

main_text.p: Generalis Physica: Th. II. Distributio Physiologiæ Aristotelicæ: ἐχϑ.1. Neotericorum distributiones: 2. Examen earum. 3. approbatio veræ sententiæ. ibid.

page.notes: Greek abbreviations after "ex" (ἐχϑ.) are uncertain in the scan and are marked [?]; the symbol may be a reference abbreviation rather than the letters shown. "Thef." is printed with long s and is given as Thes. Hyphenated line-end words keep their printed hyphens. "Erastus" is printed as "Eraftus" (long s); given as the normal form with s. The left-edge strip is the neighbouring page and is excluded. No page number is printed; "c 5" is a gathering signature.
